newsitem.title: USA: Mobil Chalmette hydrocracker seen up in day or so.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Chalmette hydrocracker seen up in day or so.

text.p: The fire at Mobil Corp's Chalmette, Louisiana refinery caused the hydrocracking unit to be shut but the damage was relatively small and the unit should be back up in a day or so, a local environmental official said Thursday.

"There was a release of hydrogen, which was localized, and they shut down the unit. The problem was that a coupling failed on a pump due to wear and tear. They are readily available parts and it looks like it'll be down just a day or so," the Louisiana Department of Environmental Quality official said.
DEQ officials inspected the plant after the fire on Thursday.
Mobil declined the comment on the operation of the plant but earlier said the fire occured in the hydrocracking unit, which upgrades middle distillates to high-octane gasoline.
The unit has a capacity to process a little under 20,000 barrels per day (bpd). The Chalmette plant has capacity to process about 173,000 bpd of crude oil.
